selection_basis: NVIDIA RULER defines QA over SQuAD or HotpotQA and documents that its default short-context tasks can approach saturation. HotpotQA was selected before any QA model score because it adds the missing realistic multi-hop QA category and is structurally less likely to saturate than single-step multikey extraction.
success_rule: The official Foundation-only string_match_part score must lie inclusively between 0.10 and 0.85, all 60 prompts must remain native and untruncated, and all task/config/model/source/commit/clean-tree invariants must pass. Only then may an ASCENT QA architecture and multi-scale gate be designed without seeing any ASCENT QA score.
failure_rule: A score below 0.10 marks the task or decoding protocol too hard/invalid; a score above 0.85 marks it saturated. Either outcome stops this QA candidate without trying ASCENT, changing the task seed, shortening the context, or substituting SQuAD after the score.
interpretation: Prospective task-selection screen only. It is not an ASCENT experiment and cannot be reported as an ASCENT gain.
